{{#if: {{{profession|}}}|{{{{{profession}}}}} }}{{item icon|{{{1|}}}|{{{2|}}}}} {{#ifeq: {{{qty|1}}} | 1 | | ({{{qty|}}}) }} {{#switch: {{ucfirst:{{{chance|Guaranteed}}}}} | Guaranteed = (guaranteed) | #default = }} {{#if: {{{collection|}}}|(Only if the [[collection]] [[{{#ask: [[Has context::Achievement]][[Has canonical name::{{{collection|}}}]]|link=none|limit=1|default={{{collection|}}}}}|{{{collection|}}}]] is active)}} {{#if: {{{hide notes|}}}||{{#if: {{{notes|}}}|({{{notes}}})}}}}{{#if: {{{no subobject|}}} ||{{#if: {{{1|}}}|{{increment|itemcnt}}{{#subobject:reward{{#var:itemcnt}} | Has context =Rewarded item | Rewards item ={{{1|}}} | Rewarded by ={{{source|{{PAGENAME}}}}} | Has rewarded item quantity ={{#if:{{{qty|}}}|{{{qty}}}|1}} | Has rewarded item chance ={{ucfirst:{{{chance|Guaranteed}}}}} | Has rewarded item id ={{{id|}}} | Has rewarded item notes ={{{notes|}}} | Is for profession ={{{profession|}}} | Has availability ={{#switch: {{lc:{{{status|{{#show: {{PAGENAME}}|?Has availability}}}}}}}|historical=Historical|discontinued=Discontinued|future=Future|unimplemented=Unimplemented}} }} }} }} == Description == Identifies what item is received upon finishing an event (page uses {{tl|event infobox}}), a story (page uses {{tl|story infobox}}) or in special cases on NPC pages, e.g. raid bosses without a related event page. Sets the [[Property:Rewards item|Rewards item]] property. ;See also * [[Personal story]] rewards are using {{tl|story reward}} * [[Dynamic event|Event]]s experience rewards are using {{tl|event rewards}} or {{tl|event reward table}} * [[Adventure]] rewards are using {{tl|Adventure rewards}} == Usage == 
{{Rewards item|}}
{{Rewards item||qty=}}
{{Rewards item|||qty=|collection=|source=|chance=|id=}}
=== Parameters === ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : Required. Name of the item. ;2 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : Optional. Link text to display. Defaults to . Do not use this to pluralize the name. ;qty : Optional. Item quantity. Defaults to 1. Stored as text, hence number ranges or full text are allowed. Not shown if equal to 1. ;collection : Optional. Set to an achievement's name to add that an item is only rewarded if the specified collection is active. ;source : Optional. Item source. Defaults to PAGENAME. ;id : Optional. Item id. For item pages with multiple variants. ;chance : Optional. Determines the reward chance. Options: "Guaranteed" (default), "Choice", or "Chance". ;notes : Optional. Can be used to add a note to the subobject, which will be displayed as an additional suffix when queried with {{tl|rewarded by}}. ;hide notes : If set to anything, will hide the notes parameter from the page, only adding it to the subobject. ;profession : Optional. Set if the item is only awarded to a specific profession, such as HoT/PoF map completion rewards. ;status : Optional. Item availability status: historical, discontinued, future, unimplemented. On default the rewarded item inherits the page availability status. Using a SMW lightweight variant which sets only [[Property:Has availability]] for non-current items (historical, discontinued, future, unimplemented). ; no subobject : If set to anything, prevents the template from setting the reward subobject. === Examples === 
* {{rewards item|Bag of Loot (Path of Fire)}}
* {{rewards item|Bag of Loot (Path of Fire)}} 
* {{rewards item|Embroidered Coin Purse|qty=2|chance=choice|notes=One of those|hide notes=y}}
* {{rewards item|Embroidered Coin Purse|qty=2|chance=choice|notes=One of those|hide notes=y}} == See also == * {{tl|rewarded by}} [[Category:Subobject templates]] [[Category:Item templates]] [[es:Plantilla:Objeto de recompensas]]
